paths.code-review.md: #2989: the diff-base fallback's git log --grep was changed from an unanchored bare phase number (matching version strings, dates, issue refs) to an anchored '[Pp]hase N\b' with --extended-regexp, plus a 5-line comment explaining the anchor. Makes the fail-closed branch reachable when no commit genuinely references the phase. #2529: the workflow gains the shared response-language directive as a single @-reference line — a uniform +63 bytes, byte-identical in each of the 43 workflows that take the reference. Prose only: no step, gate, tool invocation, or subagent dispatch shape changed.
